author: Telos I
title: AOS Admin: Activate First Development Task
abstract: Updating the AOS task list. Marking the parent planning task (21) as 'completed' and setting the first sub-task (22), 'Develop `adapter.py`', to 'active'.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

tasks = aos_manager.load_tasks()
for task in tasks:
    if task['id'] == 21:
        task['status'] = 'completed'
        task['completed_tick'] = 83
    if task['id'] == 22:
        task['status'] = 'active'
aos_manager.save_tasks(tasks)
print("Tasks 21 and 22 have been updated.")
